entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This petition is filed challenging award dated 30.08.2022 (Annexure P-3) passed by Land Acquisition Officer & Sub-Divisional Officer, Pathariya, Damoh in case No. 01 A/82 year 2021-22.

The petitioner has sought a direction to the Collector to consider the representation of the petitioner (Annexure P-8) and make a reference under Sections 64, 65 and 66 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Shri Vivek Shukla, learned Panel Lawyer has not opposed this innocuous prayer.

Accordingly, it is directed that if the petitioner files a fresh representation to the respondent No.2 - Collector, Damoh within a period of fifteen days from today, the Collector shall consider and decide the same by a speaking order in accordance with law within a further period of thirty days.
It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case.
In the above terms, the writ petition is disposed of.
